name: Alavi 2026 AlphaGenome splicing discrepancy: corrected values added from the revised preprint
description: Version 2 of Alavi 2026 reruns AlphaGenome with the coordinate fix. Its 56 AlphaGenome results are added; 28 of them rerun a version 1 scorer and replace its disputed results.

attributes.rationale: Version 2 of the preprint (posted 2026-10-31) prints AlphaGenome rows rerun with the 1-based position. It replaces version 1's three AlphaGenome rows with four: the composite score of AlphaGenome's splicing notebook, splice-site usage, splice-sites and splice-junctions. The splice-sites and splice-junctions rows rerun version 1's splice scorer and junction scorer scripts (the junction score now uses a natural-log fold change and both thresholds were re-tuned), so their 28 results replace the disputed version 1 results, which stay disputed and out of the release. The composite and splice-site usage rows are new configurations. Version 1's either-module row has no successor and stays disputed. The other models' cells are unchanged from version 1.
attributes.upstream_response: The author committed the coordinate fix to both scripts on 2026-10-23 (da0cf43e, 4a5c9163), added a merged splicing scorer on 2026-10-30 (102a107f), posted the rerun as bioRxiv version 2 on 2026-10-31 and closed issue #2 the same day. The repository was renamed to splicing-model-eval-2026.
